description: Routinize is a client-side routine automation mod for Minecraft. Create customizable routines for commands, menus, keyboard and mouse actions, with support for conditions and loops.

mods.name: Routinize
mods.description: Automates gameplay with a live-editable step sequence: scan GUI contents by item name and lore, run commands, and hold real keys and mouse buttons.

releases.notes:
## Routinize 0.1.0-beta

Initial beta release of Routinize, a client-side Fabric mod for creating routines that automate:

- Commands and timed waits
- Keyboard and mouse actions
- GUI item clicks using item names and lore
- Conditional logic with `if`, `else`, and `elseif`
- Conditional loops with `while`
- Repeating loops with `loop`
- Routine keybinds, pause/resume behavior, and configurable settings

This release may contain bugs and compatibility issues. Please report problems through the GitHub issue tracker.
